bigIdea: We are growing faster while burning less, and can break even by Q2 FY27 if we fix new-logo growth now.

beats.name: Context
beats.claim: This quarter is about growth with a shrinking burn.

beats.name: Data
beats.claim: Revenue, margin, and retention all rose this quarter.

beats.name: Insight
beats.claim: Falling burn puts cash-flow break-even at Q2 FY27, two quarters early.

beats.name: Implication
beats.claim: Flat new-logo growth is the one risk that could push break-even back.

beats.name: Action
beats.claim: Moving $600K to sales now keeps break-even at Q2 FY27.
